invariants.name: scope_patch_stays_in_subtree
invariants.note: Issue #100 / #104: patching one ThemeScope over a 64-control subtree inside a 1,000-control document must stay bounded by the scoped subtree rather than invalidating the document.

invariants.name: scope_patch_does_not_reshape
invariants.note: A color/accent ThemeScope patch must not reshape text.

invariants.name: scope_patch_does_not_lay_out
invariants.note: A color/accent ThemeScope patch must not run layout.

invariants.name: scope_patch_does_not_lay_out_the_frame
invariants.note: Cross-check against the drain: no LAYOUT was scheduled either.

invariants.name: scope_patch_does_not_copy_layout
invariants.note: A color/accent ThemeScope patch must not copy a single LayoutStyle box.

notes: Issue #100 / #104 subtree ThemeScope patch (64 controls inside a 1k-control document).
